subject: Re: MAP proposal — stacked reservation + split-tranche acceptance
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@pioneerml.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: simon.engineering@pioneerml.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: PioneerML MAP kickoff + leadtime constraints

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — PioneerML is moving toward a production pilot and we want to align on an executable MAP that accounts for both Dedicated and Private deployment lead times. Two constraints from our side:

- Compliance team needs Private (VPC) readiness within a 12-week window for the first tranche.
- Our infra team expects to start inference evaluation on a 4xH100 pool for model validation two weeks after we get staging capacity.

High-level ask: can Redwood support a split-tranche MAP where we hedge initial capacity with Dedicated GPUs (to get earlier throughput) and then commit Private capacity for regulated traffic? We care about exact lead times for H100 vs A100, staging canaries, and an acceptance sign-off cadence.

Attached: high-level timeline from our procurement team (staging dates). Would love a draft MAP we can review by the end of next week.

Cheers,
Asha Rao
VP Product, PioneerML
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Asha Rao <asha@pioneerml.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PioneerML MAP kickoff + leadtime constraints

Asha — great to hear these constraints up front. We can absolutely do a split-tranche MAP. Draft below (attached as PDF + sizing workbook):

MAP draft summary (preview):
- Tranche A (Dedicated): 4xH100 reserved for staging & eval, delivery target: 2–3 weeks after PO for hosted/dedicated pool activation.
- Tranche B (Private VPC): 8xA100 baseline (customer-managed network) with a 10–12 week visibility window for private deployment (procurement, KMS onboarding, networking).
- Canary plan: 72-hour staged canary on Dedicated → 1-week validation (latency/cost/regression) → mirror traffic to Private once readiness checklist is met.
- Acceptance criteria: throughput (tokens/s), 99th pct latency threshold, and a quality gate on prompt eval suite (we'll run your eval set in the staging environment).

I've attached a sizing worksheet with two scenarios: conservative (more A100s, slower rollout) and accelerated (larger H100 tranche initially, then scale down). Questions for PioneerML: preferred SLA for burst, quantization tolerance, and whether you need HSM/KMS provider preference documented.

I'll loop Marissa for pricing approval on the proposed tranches. If that works we can lock tranche A with a 30% refundable activation credit to shorten leadtime.

Attachments: pioneerml-map-draft-v1.pdf, gpu-sizing-estimate.xlsx

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft — short note on capacity and discount windows

Kim — quick internal note before we send final MAP:

- Lead times: H100 inventory is tighter through mid-Dec; guaranteed delivery windows shrink. If PioneerML wants H100 for Tranche A, we should recommend 'soft-lock' with partial payment to secure the pool.
- Pricing: for a dual-tranche MAP we can offer a staged commitment discount (3% for Tranche A commit, 7% if they convert to Private within 90 days).
- Risk: if they push Private earlier than 10 weeks, ops will require a retrofit fee for expedited network/security integrations.

Marissa — can you greenlight the discount ladder and the 30% activation credit for tranche A? Approving the refundable activation credit accelerates their staging by ~10 days in our provisioning queue.

-Ben
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft — short note on capacity and discount windows

Ben/Kim — approved on the staged discount ladder and the 30% refundable activation credit for Tranche A. A couple of gating items to call out for the MAP:

- Sales should capture a target acceptance window in the MAP (we often do 14 days after canary sign-off). If PioneerML needs longer, it should be time-boxed to prevent open-ended staging.
- Ops needs a 48-hour blackout before any private cutover to run security scans (add to the MAP checklist).
- Add a fallback routing policy: if Private tranches are delayed >12 weeks, auto-scale Dedicated with cost-neutral mitigation for 30 days.

Kim — send final MAP to PioneerML with those items inline and include the HubSpot deal link. I will attach the approved commercial terms in the contract package.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Asha Rao <asha@pioneerml.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: simon.engineering@pioneerml.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP proposal — stacked reservation + split-tranche acceptance

Thanks — the draft MAP looks good and aligns with our compliance timeline. A few clarifications before we sign: 

1) Staging SLA: confirm 99th pct token latency threshold (<= 250 ms) for the 4xH100 canary.
2) Private onboarding: PioneerML will use AWS KMS; can you call out steps and owners for key rotation and audit evidence delivery?
3) Cost hedge: we accept the 30% refundable activation credit for Tranche A if Redwood commits to the soft-lock on H100 availability.

Simon and I reviewed the attached sizing workbook — we prefer the accelerated scenario (start with 4xH100, scale to 12xA100 in Private after acceptance). Please send the final MAP + a DocuSign for the staged commitment.

Looking forward to getting tranche A live in the next 3 weeks.

—Asha
VP Product, PioneerML
